title: A rejected unique key leaves both collection views intact
summary: A rejected duplicate left the original list, iterator and lookup in agreement. Rebuilding the index then admitted a distinct key.

change.description: Adding a value with an occupied transformed key used to mutate the caller’s collection before rejecting it. A unique index now checks the key first.

notes: Rebuilding solely from the caller-owned collection independently checks whether the earlier exception left a valid unique index.

With identical compiled caller bytes, 4.5.0 matched the parent and 4.6.0 matched the landing on all three histories. Release 4.6.0 also evaluated the key transformer when a nonunique backing set rejected an identical element. Both PR pins accepted the same first insert and skipped this extra callback.
